scripts.1024:
if [ $1 -eq 1 ] && [ -x "/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-update-helper" ]; then 
    # Initial installation 
    /usr/lib/systemd/systemd-update-helper install-system-units inputplumber.service || : 
fi
scripts.1025:
if [ $1 -eq 0 ] && [ -x "/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-update-helper" ]; then 
    # Package removal, not upgrade 
    /usr/lib/systemd/systemd-update-helper remove-system-units inputplumber.service || : 
fi
scripts.1026:
if [ $1 -ge 1 ] && [ -x "/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-update-helper" ]; then 
    # Package upgrade, not uninstall 
    /usr/lib/systemd/systemd-update-helper mark-restart-system-units inputplumber.service || : 
fi
